errors.rate_limited: The vendor is limiting requests. It will retry later.
errors.unreachable: The vendor service can't be reached.

errors.api_changed: The vendor changed its service and this version can't read it any more. Check for an update of 3D Maker Suite.
errors.slice_failed: The slicer couldn't slice the file.

card.disabledHint: Switched off: nothing is synced, imported or offered in the app. Tick Enabled to use it and change its settings.
card.unavailableHint: The slicer's config folder wasn't found on this server. If it's on another computer, mount it here and set Config folder to that path.
card.twoInstalls: Installed twice on this server: the copy found installed here and a download. Both keep working; delete one.

account.disabledHint: Switched off: nothing is synced from this account.

deleteDialog.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteDialog.body: Imported printers and prints stay. The credentials and the sync log are removed.
deleteDialog.workerBody: A slicer the hub installed there is removed; one installed by hand stays. Its machine can still offer it again later.

login.title: Sign in to {{name}}

actionHints.openInSlicer: When active, you can open the slicer using a button on each project.
actionHints.slice: When active, this integration can be used for slicing projects.

catalog.pickHint: Pick the printer and filament brands you use. Each one brings its models and its system presets (printer, process and filament presets). The Catalog and System presets cards then change to "Only what I already have", so only what you have is checked for updates. User presets don't change.

summary.brands_other: Printer brands in your catalog: {{names, list}} and {{count}} more
summary.brandsAll: Printer brands in your catalog: {{names, list}}
summary.filamentBrands_one: Filament brands in your catalog: {{names, list}} and {{count}} more
summary.filamentBrands_other: Filament brands in your catalog: {{names, list}} and {{count}} more
summary.filamentBrandsAll: Filament brands in your catalog: {{names, list}}

catalog.readError: Couldn't read the slicer's brands. Check its folder above.
catalog.none: This slicer's system presets can't be read here, so there are no brands to pick. If it's a newer version than this app knows, update the app. Your user presets still reach the catalog.

policies.onFileChangeHint: When the slicer's files change, this runs on its own, within a minute.
policies.manualFilesHint: Nothing is written on its own. When the slicer's files change you get an alert, and you decide under "Review and import" or with Sync now.

newSpools.title: New spools
newSpools.hint: Spools that are not in the database yet.

weightHints.import: The spool is imported automatically, with the weight from the cloud.
weightHints.unset: The spool is imported automatically, without a weight.
weightHints.review: The spool is not imported: it waits for you to review it and fill in what you want.

openedAtHints.import: The spool is imported automatically, with the import date as its open date.
openedAtHints.unset: The spool is imported automatically, without an open date.
openedAtHints.review: The spool is not imported: it waits for you to review it and fill in what you want.

policies.manualHint: Runs only when you click Sync now.

summary.1MAt: Auto, every month on day {{day}} at {{time}}

at.hint: In the server's time zone. Any time: counted from the last sync.

editors.title: Editors
editors.hint: Admins always can. Editors never see the account or its settings.

policies.trackUsageOf: Take the filament of synced {{type}} from the spools
policies.trackUsageSpools: Take the remaining weight of synced spools from the vendor

scopeHints.all: Every row the source offers is added and kept up to date.
scopeHints.imported: Rows you already have are kept up to date. A new printer, printer model or spool is added only if you have its brand, so a new model of your printer brand still arrives. New slicer presets (printer, process and filament presets) are never added: only the ones you imported from this slicer are kept up to date. Start with "Review and import": filter the brand column, select all and import.

userScopeHints.all: New presets are added and changed ones updated.
userScopeHints.imported: Presets you already have are updated. A new preset raises an alert and waits for you under "Review and import".

mergeHints.overwrite: A change at the source replaces what you have, your own edits included.
mergeHints.keepEdits: Fields you changed since the last sync stay as you left them; the other fields follow the source.
mergeHints.review: Nothing you have is changed by an automatic run. When the source changes a row, you get an alert and decide under "Review and import". A change you skip there doesn't come back until the source changes again.

policies.cloudPresetsRoute: Read from your account, read-only. A machine that shares this account's presets brings them too: one way is enough. With both on, each preset is counted and reviewed once.
policies.doubleTracking: Tracking usage from both prints and spools at the same time is not recommended: the same filament can be counted twice, or the vendor's estimate can overwrite the weight your prints took off.
policies.onFileChangeReview: When the files change, after your review

slicer.title: Slicer
slicer.configDirHint: Where the slicer keeps its presets. Leave empty to use the detected one: {{dir}}
slicer.pathHint: Full path to the slicer executable, used by "Open in slicer".

worker.unavailableHint: Pick the program it runs on the device below.
worker.noDevice: Its device was revoked. Pick another one.
worker.noneYet: No slicer picked yet. Use one found on the device, or type the path of its program.
worker.pathHint: An AppImage, or any slicer that wasn't found. It's checked by starting it there with --help.
worker.checked: It runs on the device and is used from now on.

errors.smoke_failed: That program doesn't start on the device. Check the path.
errors.vcredist_missing: It needs the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64) on the device. Install it there, then try again.
errors.device_no_slicer: The device doesn't have that slicer any more.
errors.not_worker: The device isn't a slice worker. Turn it on in Hub management.
errors.device_outdated: The connector on the device is too old for slice workers. Update it to the hub's version, then try again.

worker.noPresetsHint: Its program is set. It slices once the hub has this slicer's system presets: sent by the hub's slicer, or from a zip on Catalog settings → Sources.

managed.notInstalledHint: Install the slicer below. The server downloads it from the vendor's GitHub releases and runs it itself.
managed.removeBody: Its program and presets are deleted from this server. Slicing with it stops until you install it again. Imported presets stay.

errors.fetch_failed: Couldn't download {{version}}. Check the server's internet connection and try again.
errors.bad_digest: The download of {{version}} doesn't match its checksum, so it wasn't installed.
errors.unpack_failed: Couldn't unpack {{version}}. Is there enough free disk space?
errors.smoke_failed: {{version}} was downloaded but doesn't start on this server, so it wasn't installed.
errors.vcredist_missing: {{version}} needs the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x64). Install it, then try again.
errors.device_offline: The device went offline before {{version}} was installed. Try again once it's back.

deviceErrors.fetch_failed: The device couldn't download {{version}}. Check its internet connection and try again.
deviceErrors.smoke_failed: {{version}} was downloaded but doesn't start on the device, so it wasn't installed.

managed.removeBodyDevice: Its program is deleted from the device. Slicing there stops until you install it again. The hub's presets stay.
managed.size: Download: {{size}}. Unpacked it takes a little more, plus the old version until the new one works.
managed.noStable: No stable release can be installed on this server yet. Switch on pre-releases to see the others.
managed.noneForSystem: No release has a build for this server's system.
managed.releasesError: Couldn't read the releases from GitHub. Check the server's internet connection and try again later.
managed.licence: {{name}} is AGPL-3.0 software. 3D Maker Suite downloads the vendor's own release and doesn't change it.
managed.noPresets: This slicer has no folder of yours to read. To use your brands, printers and presets here, import them from a desktop install of {{name}}:
managed.fromZip: To bring your brands, printers and presets from {{name}} on a computer that isn't connected, import them as a zip:

zipSteps.install: Install {{name}} on any computer and open it once.
zipSteps.folder: Open its config folder (Help → Show Configuration Folder), or find it yourself:
zipSteps.zip: Zip the system and user folders in it.

sync.periodHint: Opens the review with every print from that period, imported or not, so you pick what to import or update. Sync now and automatic runs always continue from the last sync.

hub.title: The hub's slicer
hub.hint: This server's installs and every machine's install can be picked.
hub.isHub: Slices this slicer type for the hub. Its catalog and system presets are the hub's, and every machine that receives them gets this copy.
hub.notOffered: Switched off, so it can't be picked. Turn it on to pick it above.
hub.offers: Has it installed, not set up yet.
hub.pickBody: The catalog and system presets change from version {{from}} to {{to}}: every machine that receives them gets the new ones, and plates sliced with the old version are sliced again.

errors.device_offline: That machine is offline. Pick it once it is online.
errors.device_outdated: The connector on that machine is too old. Update it to the hub's version, then pick it again.
errors.device_timeout: That machine didn't answer. Try again.
errors.not_an_option: It can't be the hub's slicer now: it was switched off or removed.
errors.slicer_exists: This slicer is already set up on that machine.

hub.none: No install yet. Add one to this server, or to a machine below.
hub.pickBodyUnknown: The catalog and system presets become this install's: every machine that receives them gets the new ones, and plates sliced with another version are sliced again.
hub.noneYet: None yet: set up an install below.
